Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of BLK.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1427 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 34 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2021.
Operating income reached $11.0 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 13% to 18% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 34 basis points to 45.1%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 13% to 18% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
